uncertainties: Colonial rule shown as direct control: Egypt assigned to the UK from 1900 (veiled protectorate since 1882, nominally Ottoman), Tunisia to France from 1900 (protectorate 1881), Morocco 1913 split France (MAR)/Spain (RIF) though both protectorates kept their sultan; logged because de-jure sovereignty differed.
Metropole population totals: France includes its North African territories once held; the UK figure is home islands only (Egypt's ~10-11M NOT counted) to keep the series comparable across slices.
extendsBeyondMap set true for all powers with substantial off-map empires (UK, France, Spain, Portugal, Netherlands, Denmark, Russia, Ottomans; Germany/Italy from 1900, Belgium 1913).
Montenegro (independent 1878) has no cell of its own in the 122-region tessellation (Cetinje falls inside the ALB cell); it appears in events/notes only — a known loss of fidelity.

MDA cell (Moldavia & Bessarabia) kept with the Moldavian principality and then Romania after 1812, although Bessarabia east of the Prut was Russian 1812-1918; the flip is recorded in notes to avoid a misleading Russia->Romania 'loss' in 1866.
LOM cell covers both Lombardy and Venetia: assigned to Sardinia in 1859 (Villafranca) though Venetia stayed Austrian until 1866; marked contested on both sides in 1859.
EPI cell covers both Epirus and Thessaly: assigned to Greece from 1900 (Thessaly Greek since 1881) though Ottoman Ioannina held until Feb 1913; marked contested.

SAX_L stands for Hanover 1815-1866 with Prussian Westphalia folded into RHE; FRK aggregates Hesse-Kassel, Hesse-Darmstadt, Nassau and Frankfurt under a single 'hesse' proxy entity (annexed by Prussia 1866).
German minors aggregated throughout: bavaria/wurttemberg/saxony/hanover/hesse entities stand for their smaller neighbours (Baden with Wurttemberg, Brunswick-Oldenburg with Hanover).
1812 Russian campaign: LTU/BLR/RUS_C left under Russia but flagged contested, since French occupation peaked and collapsed within the slice year.
two_sicilies id used already at the 1815 slice although the formal merger of Naples and Sicily came in December 1816.

1799 slice takes the late-1799 snapshot: Roman and Parthenopean republics already collapsed, Piedmont under Austro-Russian occupation (assigned Austria, contested), Malta and Egypt still French-garrisoned but flagged contested.
Ionian Islands (Septinsular Republic 1800-07, British 1815-64) have no cell; folded into the EPI cell's holder with mentions in UK notes only.
Ottoman population totals are contested between Karpat's census-based and McEvedy's estimates; mid-range values (~22-28M for the whole empire) used throughout.
Crete: shown as autonomous crete_state 1900-1908 and Greek from the 1913 slice; the 1908 enosis declaration was unrecognized until 1913.

Algeria 1830: Algiers city falls in the NUM cell, so France holds NUM (contested) while ORA remains with the collapsing Regency's successors; full conquest shown complete by 1848 (Abd el-Kader surrendered Dec 1847).
